subject.title: ci: scope PR Node tests to changed targets

question: Should canonical pull requests replace the full 14-job compact Node matrix with changed-target one-job planning before a hosted targeted-path canary has been demonstrated?
rationale: This deliberately trades routine pull-request coverage for runner capacity, and tests cannot prove every repository dependency edge or GitHub Actions integration path; the protected maintainer signal makes acceptance of that residual automation risk a human policy choice.

options.title: Require split and hosted canaries
options.body: Remove both unrelated changes and require redacted hosted runs proving the targeted one-job path and compact fallback before merge.

options.title: Accept the tested residual risk
options.body: Land the planner based on Testbox and fixture coverage while explicitly accepting that the targeted GitHub Actions path has not been observed end to end.

options.title: Retain full PR coverage
options.body: Pause or close the optimization and keep the 14-job compact matrix until a narrower selection mechanism has stronger operational proof.

recommendation.title: Require split and hosted canaries
recommendation.body: Remove both unrelated changes and require redacted hosted runs proving the targeted one-job path and compact fallback before merge.
